overview: Experience the best of Australia with this 10-day itinerary. Begin in Sydney with a city tour, exploring landmarks like Darling Harbour and Bondi Beach. Choose between Sydney Aquarium or Wildlife World and visit iconic attractions such as the Sydney Tower or Madame Tussauds. Venture to the Blue Mountains for scenic wonders and wildlife encounters, then transfer to the Gold Coast for leisure and theme park thrills at Movie World and Sea World. Continue to Melbourne, where

days.title: Arrival Into Sydney
days.body: Upon your arrival at Sydney Airport, our team will be there to greet you and assist you with your transfer to the hotel. Please note that while we will do our best to accommodate early check-in requests, it cannot be guaranteed and is subject to availability. Once you arrive at the hotel, you will proceed with the check-in process and then have the rest of the day to settle in and relax. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel, preparing for the adventures that await you in Sydney. (Dinner)

days.title: Sydney Half Day Tour With Bondi Beach And Combination Attraction Tickets
days.body: Embark on an exciting city tour of Sydney, starting with a visit to the vibrant Darling Harbour, one of the world's premier waterfront destinations. Explore the historical Rocks area, bustling Central Business District (CBD), and tranquil Hyde Park. Marvel at the iconic Harbour Bridge and enjoy scenic views from Mrs. Macquaries Chair. Discover the allure of the Eastern suburbs and relax at the famous Bondi Beach. Choose between a visit to Sydney Aquarium or Wildlife World to experience Australia's diverse wildlife. Optionally, ascend Sydney Tower for panoramic views and enjoy a 4D Movie. Alternatively, explore the glamour of Madame Tussauds Wax Museum. After a day of exploration, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay, having experienced the best of Sydney's attractions. (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner)

days.title: Full Day Blue Mountains Tour
days.body: Enjoy a scenic stop at Echo Point to admire the famous Three Sisters rock formation. Then, experience the thrilling Scenic World rides - Scenic Railway, Cableway, or Skyway. Next, head to the charming Leura village for a leisurely lunch (at your own expense) and explore its unique boutiques and galleries. In the afternoon, visit Featherdale Wildlife Park to interact with Australia's iconic wildlife, including koalas, kangaroos, wombats, dingoes, and penguins. Finally, return to Sydney by approximately 6:00 pm after an unforgettable day of natural wonders and wildlife encounters. (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner)

days.title: Transfer From Sydney To Gold Coast Via Brisbane Airport
days.body: fter enjoying a delicious breakfast at the hotel, complete the check-out process. Hop on the coach for a seamless transfer to Sydney Airport, where you will catch your flight to Brisbane. Upon arrival in Brisbane, take another coach for a comfortable transfer to your hotel. Check in and settle into your accommodation. The rest of the day is yours to explore the vibrant Gold Coast at your leisure. Enjoy the freedom to discover the charm of the Gold Coast at your own pace. (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner)

days.title: Full Day Movie World
days.body: After breakfast, embark on an exciting full-day excursion to Movie World. Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Warner Bros, where everyone is a star! Experience galactic excitement as you brave the steepest drop in the world on the newly introduced Green Lantern Rollercoaster. Explore Movie World and let fantasy and fun take over. Encounter your favorite stars and superheroes, and enjoy world-class adventure rides such as the awe-inspiring Batwing Spaceshot and the adrenaline-pumping Superman Escape. The Kids’ WB! Fun Zone offers a colorful haven for the young and the young at heart, with a magical cartoon world to explore. Be sure not to miss the sensational multi-million dollar live-action stunt show, 'Hollywood Stunt Driver,' presented by Castrol Edge. Experience the spectacular Star Parade, adding to the magic of the day. After a day filled with cinematic adventures, return to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay, cherishing the memories of your Movie World experience. (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner)

days.title: Full Day Sea World
days.body: Embark on a full-day tour to Sea World after breakfast. Dive into a realm of excitement, interacting with dolphins and exploring Bikini Bottom. Enjoy stage shows with Dora the Explorer and the captivating performances of Sea Lions. Experience Castaway Bay and Penguin Encounter. Sea World offers thrilling rides, including the world's first SpongeBob parade. Witness the charm and beauty of Sea World's dolphins in the captivating show 'Imagine.' Be entertained by the clever and humorous Sea Lions in their amusing performance, 'Fish Detectives.' Explore the world's best adventure playground at Castaway Bay. Conclude your adventure and return to the hotel in the evening for a comfortable overnight stay, reflecting on the joy and wonder of your Sea World experience. (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner)

days.title: Transfer From Gold Coast To Melbourne
days.body: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before checking out. Board a coach for a transfer to Brisbane Airport to catch your flight to Melbourne. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and check in. Spend the rest of the day exploring Melbourne at your own pace, discovering its vibrant neighborhoods, iconic landmarks, and renowned culinary scene. (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner)

days.title: Excursion To Phillip Island Penguin, Brighton Beach, Moonlit Sanctuary
days.body: Departing Melbourne around midday, our adventure begins with a visit to the iconic Brighton Beach bathing boxes, one of the city's most vibrant attractions. Spend some time at the beach, admiring these historic landmarks that offer a unique glimpse into Melbourne's cultural and seaside heritage. Next, we head to the Moonlit Sanctuary Wildlife Conservation Park, where you'll enjoy a guided wildlife walk and have the chance to hand-feed various native Australian animals. Immerse yourself in the rich biodiversity, learning about iconic species such as kangaroos, koalas, emus, and wallabies, as well as lesser-known favorites like quolls, owls, bandicoots, and Tasmanian devils. At the sanctuary, witness the captivating "Conservation in Action" wildlife show, which showcases several lesser-known Australian species through interactive ranger presentations. Continuing to Phillip Island, we stop at Point Grant and The Nobbies to enjoy panoramic views over Westernport Bay and Bass Strait, including Seal Rocks, home to Australia's largest population of fur seals. The highlight of the day is the Phillip Island penguin tour, where just after dark, the world's smallest penguins make their way ashore after a day spent fishing at sea. Your guide will ensure you have the best vantage point to witness this natural spectacle up close as the adorable penguins waddle ashore on their journey back to their homes. After the Penguin Parade, there's ample time to explore the visitor centre and learn more about these fascinating creatures before we begin our journey back to Melbourne. (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner)

days.title: Full Day Great Ocean Road Tour
days.body: Embark on the renowned 1 Day Great Ocean Road Tour, showcasing Melbourne's breathtaking coastline and the iconic 12 Apostles. Begin with a stop at Urquhart Bluff, a famous surf beach, and enjoy morning tea while watching surfers conquer waves. Explore picturesque coastal towns like Lorne and Anglesea before indulging in a satisfying lunch. Traverse the enchanting Otway rainforest to witness the majestic 12 Apostles and explore the rugged shipwreck coast, including Loch Ard Gorge and Gibsons Steps. Conclude the day with a return to Melbourne, ensuring a memorable experience filled with scenic landscapes and cultural stops. (Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner)

days.title: Departure From Melbourne
days.body: Complete your hotel check-out after breakfast. Our team will arrange your airport transfer for your return flight home. Cherish the memories from your Melbourne trip and we hope to host you again in the future! Safe travels! (Breakfast)
